descripcion_corta: The original Japanese version of the RPG classic.
descripcion_larga: Maou Golvellius is a vibrant and challenging adventure. Explore the Valley of Doom, battle through top-down and side-scrolling dungeons, and upgrade your gear to stop the ultimate evil in this Sega staple.

objetivo: Reach the goal before the timer runs out.
descripcion_corta: A faithful port of the unique arcade physics game.
descripcion_larga: Marble Madness on the Master System is an impressive conversion. Navigate your marble through surreal, obstacle-filled courses while battling gravity and enemies in this classic test of reflexes and precision.

objetivo: Achieve the high score in target and trap shooting.
descripcion_corta: A two-game pack designed for the Light Phaser.
descripcion_larga: Marksman Shooting & Trap Shooting offers a variety of range-based challenges. Test your aim and reaction time in these competitive arcade-style events that showcase the accuracy of the Master System gun.

nombre: Marksman Shooting & Trap Shooting & Safari Hunt (Europe)
objetivo: Clear the range and survive the jungle safari.
descripcion_corta: A three-game compilation for the Light Phaser.
descripcion_larga: This European exclusive bundle brings together Marksman Shooting, Trap Shooting, and Safari Hunt. It provides the ultimate light gun experience, offering everything from competitive targets to hunting wild animals.

objetivo: Navigate the test environment and reach the end.
descripcion_corta: A modern homebrew demo for the Master System.
descripcion_larga: Martlet's Fun Adventure! Demo is a showcase of what modern developers can do with 8-bit hardware. Experience smooth scrolling and creative mechanics in this impressive community-driven technical demonstration.

objetivo: Stop Count Dracula and his army of the undead.
descripcion_corta: A dark action game similar to Castlevania.
descripcion_larga: Master of Darkness is a Victorian-era masterpiece. Play as Dr. Social as you battle through London’s fog and gothic castles, using a variety of weapons to hunt down the king of vampires in this atmospheric title.

objetivo: Defeat all rivals to become the grand champion.
descripcion_corta: A late-release 1v1 fighter with large sprites.
descripcion_larga: Masters of Combat is one of the best fighting games on the system. Featuring a diverse roster of fighters with unique special moves, it offers a surprisingly deep and fluid combat experience for the hardware.

objetivo: Find the exit of the labyrinth and defeat the boss.
descripcion_corta: A unique 3D maze crawler for Sega's 3D Glasses.
descripcion_larga: Maze Hunter 3-D uses the Master System's 3D capabilities to create a sense of depth. Navigate through complex mazes from a top-down perspective, using the "pop-out" effect to better judge distances and enemies.

objetivo: Collect items and find the exit of each level.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese version of the 3D maze game.
descripcion_larga: Maze Walker (known as Maze Hunter 3-D elsewhere) is a challenging test of direction and reflexes. Explore dozens of levels filled with power-ups and monsters in this innovative use of the console's 3D technology.

objetivo: Put out fires and rescue civilians from buildings.
descripcion_corta: A unique paddle-controller rescue game.
descripcion_larga: Megumi Rescue is a rare Japanese gem. Use a trampoline-like mechanic to bounce firefighters up the side of burning buildings to save people, offering a frantic and original take on the rescue genre.

objetivo: Infiltrate enemy territory and rescue the President.
descripcion_corta: High-octane arcade shooting action.
descripcion_larga: Mercs delivers intense vertical-scrolling combat. As a member of an elite mercenary squad, use a variety of heavy weaponry and power-ups to blast through enemy lines in this faithful 8-bit conversion of the Capcom classic.

objetivo: Rescue children and defeat Mr. Big using dance moves.
descripcion_corta: Iconic action game based on Michael Jackson's film.
descripcion_larga: Moonwalker features the King of Pop in a stylized battle against crime. Use signature dance moves to defeat enemies and explore urban environments in this rhythm-infused platformer with a legendary 8-bit soundtrack.

nombre: Mick & Mack as the Global Gladiators (Europe)
objetivo: Clean up pollution and reach the goal.
descripcion_corta: A fast-paced McDonald's branded environmental quest.
descripcion_larga: Global Gladiators is a visually stunning late-era title. Help Mick and Mack use their slime-shooters to battle pollution monsters across vibrant worlds in this fluidly animated and challenging platformer.

objetivo: Complete logic and memory games to find the beans.
descripcion_corta: A brain-teasing Disney adventure for all ages.
descripcion_larga: Mickey's Ultimate Challenge brings a collection of clever mini-games to the Master System. Solve puzzles in a fairy-tale kingdom to earn magic beans and uncover the mystery of the strange clouds.

objetivo: Finish first on creative household tracks.
descripcion_corta: Frantic racing with tiny cars in everyday settings.
descripcion_larga: Micro Machines is a masterpiece of 8-bit racing. Compete on breakfast tables and bathtubs, navigating obstacles and outperforming rivals in this highly addictive and technically impressive miniature racer.

nombre: Miracle Warriors - Seal of the Dark Lord (USA, Europe)
objetivo: Recruit three companions and defeat the Dark Lord.
descripcion_corta: An epic and expansive early 8-bit RPG.
descripcion_larga: Miracle Warriors offers a massive world map and challenging first-person dungeons. Master the turn-based combat and manage your party's reputation to restore peace to the land in this deep fantasy quest.

nombre: Miracle Warriors - Seal of the Dark Lord (USA, Europe) (Beta)
objetivo: Recruit three companions and defeat the Dark Lord.
descripcion_corta: Beta version of the sprawling fantasy RPG.
descripcion_larga: Experience the early build of Miracle Warriors. This version showcases the foundational turn-based combat and exploration mechanics that made the final release a landmark title for RPG fans on the system.

objetivo: Intercept nuclear missiles before they hit the city.
descripcion_corta: High-stakes defense using Sega 3D Glasses.
descripcion_larga: Missile Defense 3-D utilizes 3D technology to create an immersive sky-view combat experience. Aim and fire with precision to stop waves of incoming missiles in this intense and unique hardware showcase.

objetivo: Use your sword to defeat the dragon and save the day.
descripcion_corta: A Brazilian re-skin of Wonder Boy in Monster Land.
descripcion_larga: Mônica no Castelo do Dragão features the beloved Brazilian comic character. Explore a fantasy world, buy gear, and battle mythical creatures in this legendary localized version of a Sega classic.

objetivo: Bankrupt your opponents by buying properties.
descripcion_corta: A faithful 8-bit digital version of the board game.
descripcion_larga: Monopoly brings the classic property-trading game to the Master System. Featuring animated tokens and varied computer difficulties, it offers a complete strategic experience for up to four players.

objetivo: Bankrupt your opponents by buying properties.
descripcion_corta: North American release of the classic property game.
descripcion_larga: Trade, build houses, and collect rent in this US version of Monopoly. The game perfectly translates the tabletop strategy to the 8-bit screen with clear visuals and smooth turn-based gameplay.

objetivo: Find the treasure while avoiding traps and skulls.
descripcion_corta: A challenging pyramid-climbing adventure.
descripcion_larga: Montezuma's Revenge (featuring Panama Joe) is a pioneer of the action-adventure genre. Navigate a deadly Aztec temple, collect keys, and master precise jumps to claim the ultimate treasure in this retro classic.

objetivo: Defeat Shang Tsung in the tournament of champions.
descripcion_corta: A blood-pumping 8-bit port of the arcade hit.
descripcion_larga: Mortal Kombat brings the legendary fighters to the Master System. Execute special moves and fatalities in this impressive conversion that maintains the dark atmosphere and competitive spirit of the original.

objetivo: Win the final battle against Shao Kahn.
descripcion_corta: A rare 8-bit port of the third MK entry.
descripcion_larga: Mortal Kombat 3 on the Master System is a technical feat from the Brazilian market. Featuring a varied roster and the series' signature fast-paced combat, it offers a brutal 1v1 experience for late-gen fans.

objetivo: Travel to Outworld and defeat Shao Kahn.
descripcion_corta: A fluid and colorful sequel to the fighting hit.
descripcion_larga: Mortal Kombat II features more characters and refined controls. Battle through diverse arenas and master the improved combo system in this high-quality 8-bit fighting game conversion.

objetivo: Eat all the pellets while avoiding the ghosts.
descripcion_corta: A polished home version of the arcade sequel.
descripcion_larga: Ms. Pac-Man offers the classic fruit-munching gameplay with multiple maze layouts. Experience the speed and charm of the arcade original on your Master System with smooth animation and iconic sound effects.

objetivo: Rescue your girlfriend from the street gang.
descripcion_corta: A fast-paced and challenging urban brawler.
descripcion_larga: My Hero features a relentless pace as you punch and kick your way through city streets. Face off against tough bosses and avoid hazards in this early Sega classic that rewards quick reflexes.

objetivo: Win the high school baseball championship.
descripcion_corta: A Japanese exclusive high-school baseball sim.
descripcion_larga: Nekkyuu Koushien focuses on the passion of youth baseball. Manage your team and execute perfect plays to climb the tournament brackets in this culturally rich and mechanically sound 8-bit sports title.

objetivo: Rescue your friends across different lands.
descripcion_corta: A whimsical and colorful arcade conversion.
descripcion_larga: The New Zealand Story features Wiki the kiwi in a massive, vibrant world. Use various weapons and vehicles to navigate trap-filled levels and save your fellow birds in this charming and difficult adventure.

objetivo: Infiltrate the castle and defeat the evil ninja.
descripcion_corta: The original Japanese version of The Ninja.

objetivo: Recover the dragon sword and avenge your father.
descripcion_corta: A legendary and difficult cinematic ninja quest.
descripcion_larga: Ninja Gaiden on the Master System is a unique title distinct from the NES version. Featuring smooth wall-jumping and fast-paced swordplay, Ryu Hayabusa must navigate treacherous stages and face massive bosses.

objetivo: Recover the dragon sword and avenge your father.
descripcion_corta: Beta version of the cinematic ninja action game.
descripcion_larga: Experience the development of Ryu's 8-bit quest. This Beta version of Ninja Gaiden offers a look at the level design and combat mechanics that made the final European release a highly sought-after classic.

objetivo: Infiltrate the castle and defeat the evil ninja.
descripcion_corta: The international release of the stealth-actioner.
descripcion_larga: The Ninja features challenging overhead combat. Use your invisibility powers and master the trajectory of your shurikens to navigate through enemy-filled forests and castles in this 8-bit arcade port.

objetivo: Win the gold medal in the Barcelona '92 events.
descripcion_corta: The official licensed game of the 1992 Olympics.
descripcion_larga: Olympic Gold features events like 100m sprint, archery, and swimming. With three difficulty levels and a focus on timing and button-mashing, it offers a highly competitive and polished sports experience.

objetivo: Win the gold medal in the Barcelona '92 events.
descripcion_corta: Korean edition of the official Olympic game.
descripcion_larga: Compete for glory in the Korean version of Olympic Gold. Master the various athletic disciplines and climb the podium in this international sports title that pushed the boundaries of 8-bit animation.

objetivo: Defend the solar system from invaders.
descripcion_corta: A unique spin-off featuring the Fantasy Zone hero.
descripcion_larga: Opa Opa (known as Fantasy Zone: The Maze in some regions) features top-down maze navigation and shooting. Collect coins to buy weapon upgrades and clear dozens of colorful, enemy-filled rooms.

objetivo: Rescue hostages and escape the enemy base.
descripcion_corta: A high-tension arcade shooting conversion.
descripcion_larga: Operation Wolf is a masterpiece of light gun action. Compatible with the Light Phaser, you must manage your ammo and grenades while blasting through jungle and prison camps to complete your rescue mission.

objetivo: Find the mysterious Ottifants and reach the goal.
descripcion_corta: A quirky and colorful cartoon platformer.
